#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
logs=$base/logs
out=$1

if [ ! -d "$logs" ]; then
    printf 'log directory not found: %s\n' "$logs" >&2
    exit 1
fi

umask 077
mkdir -p -- "$out"
out=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$out" && pwd -P)
case $out in
    "$logs"|"$logs"/*)
        printf 'output directory must be outside %s\n' "$logs" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

if find "$out" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then
    printf 'output directory must be empty: %s\n' "$out" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Do not follow or copy symlinks. Report outward-pointing links explicitly.
find -P "$logs" -type l -print | while IFS= read -r link; do
    target=$(readlink -f -- "$link" 2>/dev/null || true)
    case $target in
        "$logs"|"$logs"/*) : ;;
        *) printf 'skipping symlink outside logs: %s\n' "${link#"$logs"/}" >&2 ;;
    esac
done

# Recreate nested real directories, then sanitize only regular files.
find -P "$logs" -mindepth 1 -type d -print | while IFS= read -r src; do
    rel=${src#"$logs"/}
    mkdir -p -- "$out/$rel"
done

find -P "$logs" -type f -print | while IFS= read -r src; do
    rel=${src#"$logs"/}
    dst=$out/$rel
    parent=${dst%/*}
    mkdir -p -- "$parent"
    LC_ALL=C sed -E \
        -e 's/[[:alnum:]._%+-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\.[[:alpha:]]{2,}/[REDACTED]/g' \
        -e 's/("auth_token"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)"[^"]*"/\1"[REDACTED]"/gI' \
        -e "s/('auth_token'[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)'[^']*'/\1'[REDACTED]'/gI" \
        -e 's/(auth_token[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)[^[:space:],;}]+/\1[REDACTED]/gI' \
        -- "$src" > "$dst"
done

sha256sum "$BASE/bin/export" "$BACKUP_DIR/bin-export.pre-repair"
